tagline: Himalayan valleys, snow adventures and cafe-lined riversides
signatureFood: siddu, trout fish, thukpa, babru, Himachali dham

seasons.label: Spring and summer
seasons.note: Pleasant and open; Rohtang Pass and Atal Tunnel routes are typically accessible from May.

seasons.label: Monsoon
seasons.note: Heavy rain and landslide risk on mountain roads; adventure activities may be suspended.

seasons.label: Autumn
seasons.note: Clear skies and crisp air; good for sightseeing before the snow.

seasons.label: Winter
seasons.note: Snowfall at Solang and Sissu; Rohtang is closed and roads can be icy, so allow extra travel time.

places.name: Hadimba Devi Temple
places.desc: 16th-century wooden pagoda temple set in a deodar forest.

places.name: Old Manali Cafes and Village Walk
places.desc: Riverside village with live-music cafes, trout restaurants, apple orchards and handicraft shops.

places.name: Solang Valley Adventure Day
places.desc: Meadow valley for paragliding, zorbing, ropeway rides and snow activities in winter; activity prices vary.

places.name: Rohtang Pass Excursion
places.desc: High mountain pass with snow views; needs a vehicle permit, is weather-dependent and closed in winter.

places.name: Atal Tunnel and Sissu
places.desc: Drive through the 9 km Atal Tunnel to Sissu in Lahaul valley for waterfall and snow-peak views.

places.name: Vashisht Hot Springs and Temple
places.desc: Village with natural sulphur hot springs and old stone temples.

places.name: Mall Road Shopping and Street Food
places.desc: Pedestrian market for Kullu shawls, woollens, handicrafts and street food.

places.name: Jogini Waterfall Trek
places.desc: Easy 3 km forest trail from Vashisht to a two-tier waterfall.

places.name: River Rafting on the Beas
places.desc: Guided white-water rafting on the Beas; usually runs outside monsoon and deep winter.

places.name: Naggar Castle and Roerich Art Gallery
places.desc: Medieval wooden-stone castle and the Nicholas Roerich art gallery with valley views.

places.name: Traditional Himachali Dham Lunch
places.desc: Himachali lunch of siddu, madra and rice served in a traditional setting.
